name: Northville
seo_title: Northville Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 4 Events, 3 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Northville, Michigan for 2026: 4 family events, 3 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Northville's Christmas for kids is a farm-and-library mix: Santa and trains at Three Cedars Farm, Santa in the barn at Maybury Farm, free photos with Santa and a library Winter Extravaganza.
celebrates: Northville families head to the farms. Three Cedars Farm on Six Mile Road runs Country Christmas from November 27 to December 20, with free admission, Santa, a petting farm and train rides. Maybury Farm opens its barn for Santa Visits on two December weekends. The Northville Pickleball Club offers free photos with Santa on December 5, and the Northville District Library holds its free Winter Extravaganza on December 15. Downtown Northville's parade and tree lighting were held on November 20.
lastyear: Downtown Northville's Hometown Holiday Lighted Parade and Tree Lighting, with the 2026 theme Home for the Holidays, was held on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 6:30 pm, according to the Northville DDA, so it is not on this page. We did not find a host recap of the 2025 farm events, so this page relies on the 2026 schedules.
facts: Maybury Farm, at 50165 Eight Mile Road, is run with the Northville Community Foundation, which was founded on July 2, 1997 to enhance and enrich life in the community. Three Cedars Farm is at 7897 Six Mile Road and accepts cash, credit or debit cards. Northville Parks and Recreation is at 44405 Six Mile Road.
trains: Three Cedars Farm lists train rides among its Country Christmas activities. For heritage rail, The Henry Ford's Greenfield Village in Dearborn has a railroad with an 1884 roundhouse, and the Michigan Transit Museum in Mount Clemens is a volunteer-run museum in an 1859 Grand Trunk depot. Check each page for current rides.

kidfact: Three Cedars Farm has train rides, a petting farm and a kids' outdoor play land.
faq: Is there a train ride in Northville?
Three Cedars Farm, 7897 Six Mile Road, lists train rides among its Country Christmas activities from November 27 to December 20, 2026. Parking and admission are free according to the farm's homepage.
Where can kids see Santa in Northville?
Three Cedars Farm has Santa hours on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays, Maybury Farm hosts Santa Visits on December 5, 6, 12 and 13, and the Northville Pickleball Club has free photos on December 5.
Are there free events in Northville?
Yes. Country Christmas at Three Cedars Farm, the pickleball club's photos with Santa and the Northville District Library's Winter Extravaganza are all listed as free.
When is the Northville Christmas parade?
The Hometown Holiday Lighted Parade and Tree Lighting was on Friday, November 20, 2026, at 6:30 pm, so it has passed.
